messages:
Noah Kim: Heads-up 12 - AsterBio (healthcare analytics) wants to run a POC using their tuned `bloom-7b-med` variant. Main asks: can we serve their repo weights (private HF) with NF4 quant and meet enterprise SLOs? They also need evidence for certs (SOC2) and DPA before any data flows.
Priya Singh: Do they provide the full checkpoint or a LoRA? Also ask for expected avg prompt length + tokens per convo. Those change the perf profile a lot.
Noah Kim: They sent a private HF link and say it's a full checkpoint plus a ~25MB LoRA. Link will be shared after DPA sign.
Julian Park: Quick runtime notes: bloom-7b architecture is generally OK with nf4 on H100 with our kernel set, but we need to validate the tokenizer. Often custom tokenizers (new special tokens) are the first blocker.
Maia Lopez: For compliance: we require either Private (VPC) deployment or Dedicated with customer-managed KMS for PHI. Also they must confirm logging opt-outs for training data retention. I'll prepare the standard SOC2 + DPA checklist.
Julian Park: Suggested test plan:
```
1) run tokenizer sanity: python tools/tokenizer_check.py --repo asterbio/bloom-7b-med
2) export adapter: python tools/export_adapter.py --repo asterbio/bloom-7b-med --out /tmp/adapter.pt
3) quant conversion (nf4): python tools/convert_to_nf4.py --weights /tmp/adapter.pt --out /tmp/adapter_nf4.pt
```
Julian Park: If the convert script errors on custom ops, it's a blocker; ping here with the error output.
Priya Singh: Perf SLO: AsterBio wants p95 < 120ms for short dialogs (~64 tokens). Thats tighter than typical. We should recommend H100 x2 for a stable baseline during pilot plus KV cache warmers.
Noah Kim: Pricing ask: can you give a quick dedicated estimate for SE to include in the term sheet?
Maia Lopez: Ballpark: 1 H100 (dev) for hosted pilot ~ $9k/mo. For guaranteed Dedicated capacity hitting p95 <120ms at scale I'd quote 2xH100 reserved ~ $28k/mo. Add 10-20% for high-availability and burst. If they prefer A100-only regions, expect +25% due to larger memory/less efficient kernels with nf4 fallback.
Julian Park: Also propose a fallback variant `bloom-7b-med-8bit` for A100 and older clusters; we'll run an A/B on quality using our med-regress-v2 eval set before recommending NF4 for production.
Priya Singh: Ops detail: we should ask for list of third-party libs in their HF repo (e.g., patched attention modules). If present, require a security review. Use `git ls-tree -r --name-only` on the repo tarball to scan.
Noah Kim: Action items: (1) Priya to request repo access + dependency list + expected QPS by EOD (2) Julian to try tokenizer + nf4 conversion on a smoke VM and report failures by EOD+1 (3) Maia to send DPA + SOC2 checklist and pricing note to buyer.
ops-bot: ticket #INF-7453 opened: "AsterBio 12 bloom-7b-med onboarding + nf4 conversion" assigned to Julian, Priya, Maia.
Noah Kim: If conversion succeeds, we'll propose a 2-week pilot (private hosted) before committing to Dedicated. Also ask buyer whether they need SIEM integration or syslog forwarding.
Priya Singh: Noted. I'll push for the dependency list now.
Julian Park: One more: if adapter uses fused kernels we might need to rebuild wheels. Flag me immediately if compilation is required.
Maia Lopez: I'll include KMS/HSM options in the checklist (customer-managed recommended).
Noah Kim: Great, thanks team. I'll update the buyer after the EOD check-ins. :sparkles:
